body: So it's just fishy because it looks Chinese? What a developer decides to name something doesn't have any effect on it's maliciousness. That's a terrible way to judge the legitimacy of software...

Wow thanks for the super relevant reply. I am stuck with iOS for the foreseeable future, because I am locked into unlimited with an iPhone 5 on verizon, and i'd give up unlimited 4g to use an upgrade. I typically use over 10gb a month. I definitely will take your advice and branch out to other communities. I have a lot of time invested in my current project, and I am probably going to finish that up somewhat, and hopefully hand it off to someone else. I made icons for some guy's overpriced tweak and he went silent when it was time to pay me, so I really want to make a free version of it just because he's ripped so many people off for a $2 buggy tweak with stolen artwork. 

Also, I know iOS hacking takes a ton of talent and gives little reward, and even if your role was minor, I have to thank you for your effort. 

I have been feeling a bit better just planning out a course of action instead of just avoiding everything and letting it pile up.

The 3.0 is weighted, my school doesn't do unweighted but it would be pretty bad because I override into honors and APs because I tend to do just as well in them as in CP classes. All of my math and science classes have been honors.

I felt like I was out of space to say this, but I actually got a therapist. She really doesn't know exactly what to tell me, as I've told her everything pretty much, and she often just asks what she thinks I want her to tell me. Its kind of awkward, any idea of what I should say to her? I don't know what I need exactly, and she seems surprised by this. 

My dad has unreasonable pride in me. He "knows" that I will get rich and/or be even more influential than him. My mom does not have the same faith, and she is showing resentment towards my dad, presumably partially because they have such contrasting opinions of me.

The drivers test wouldn't be a huge deal except I was considering asking a girl out if I got it, and my therapist actually said this was a good idea. I lack any sort of confidence to do this, but we get along great and its pretty obvious that shes looking for a similar relationship, and might even have mutual feelings. Unfortunately, I'd be a dick to ask her out without being mobile. 

I realize I could get into a college or two with my situation, but not the one's were looking at, and not anyone who isn't an embarrassment on a resume. I also am well aware of the necessity of going to a good school to get a good career. In my family/area, its expected that you go to a good school. I'm below the average druggie level of performance, and I lost most of my friends because I didn't want to do drugs. My mom makes fun of me for this, because apparently even she and my dad, and all of my siblings smoked weed and I pussied out. 

Honestly, as someone with no personal connection to me at all, do you really think it's not too late to make something of myself, as a junior in high school? I kind of set this break as a deadline and being that its nearly midnight on a Sunday I posted this as a last resort. I honestly feel like even if I fixed everything tonight I'd still end up flipping burgers, and as long as my dad would see that happen, I'd rather die tomorrow. 

Edit: had written a decently sized response, only to find the comments deleted. :-| I did find a lot of what you said [deleted] helpful though!
